primary_sources.title: VMem: Consistent Interactive Video Scene Generation with Surfel-Indexed View Memory
primary_sources.supports: Surfel-indexed view memory stores and retrieves historical views for revisit consistency.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: A fixed-state, single-source total causal effect localized to the source geometry support.

primary_sources.title: Video World Models with Long-term Spatial Memory
primary_sources.supports: Spatial, working and episodic memory are processed and injected as a conditional signal.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Per-source causal acceptance or output-region localization.

primary_sources.title: WorldMem: Long-term Consistent World Simulation with Memory
primary_sources.supports: Memory units pair frames with state information and are consumed by state-aware memory attention.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Fixed-state counterfactual attribution of one runtime memory item.

primary_sources.title: Learning World Models for Interactive Video Generation
primary_sources.supports: Naive long context or RAG can be ineffective when the video generator has limited in-context learning; explicit global state conditioning is introduced.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Runtime source-to-region causal intervention.

primary_sources.title: Context as Memory: Scene-Consistent Interactive Long Video Generation with Memory Retrieval
primary_sources.venue_status: SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 author project page and arXiv
primary_sources.code_status: Author project page displayed GitHub as Coming Soon at retrieval time.
primary_sources.supports: Historical frames are selected using field-of-view overlap and provided as frame-formatted context.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Causal source attribution or evidence acceptance.

primary_sources.title: Memory Forcing: Spatio-Temporal Memory for Consistent Scene Generation on Minecraft
primary_sources.supports: Shows that over-reliance on insufficient spatial context can harm novel-scene generation, then uses hybrid temporal and spatial memory training, chained forward training, geometry-indexed memory, and point-to-frame retrieval.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: It already adapts memory use across exploration and revisit regimes, but does not report a per-query, fixed-state, single-source causal localization and acceptance protocol.

primary_sources.title: Teaching Video Generators to Remember: Eliciting Dynamic Memory for Out-of-Sight State Evolution
primary_sources.code_status: Public README exposed inference; training code was not present at retrieval time.
primary_sources.supports: Uses memory-oriented frame graphs, protected anchors, node dropping, noisy memory, reference-cache training, PM-RoPE, and non-contiguous streaming KV cache; it also studies memory or KV importance and trains with candidate memories of differing reliability.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Method and appendix review did not identify a fixed-state intervention on one selected runtime memory source that estimates its total generated-region causal effect. This bounded statement does not deny ReMind's reliability training, anchor retrieval, or importance diagnostics.

primary_sources.title: Addressable Memory for Video World Models
primary_sources.code_status: No official code repository was retrieved in the recorded targeted searches.
primary_sources.supports: Out-of-training positional offsets and compression in RoPE space can make stored KV content unaddressable; virtual in-distribution positions are proposed.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Whether addressed evidence is correct, causally consumed or localized in the output.

primary_sources.title: What the DAAM: Interpreting Stable Diffusion Using Cross Attention
primary_sources.supports: Aggregated cross-attention maps provide word-to-image spatial attribution validated against segmentation and human attribution.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Causal effect of a runtime image-memory source.

primary_sources.title: I2AM: Interpreting Image-to-Image Latent Diffusion Models via Bi-Attribution Maps
primary_sources.supports: Aggregates cross-attention across diffusion steps, heads, and layers into reference-to-generated and generated-to-reference maps; SRAM maps a selected generated patch to reference patches, and the maps are evaluated against object boxes and task masks with a random-region baseline and attention-guided refinement.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: It does not intervene on a reference under fixed state or estimate a causal total effect. Mask alignment, random-box comparison, and attention-guided refinement remain non-causal evidence about a runtime memory item.

primary_sources.title: Localizing and Editing Knowledge in Text-to-Image Generative Models
primary_sources.supports: Causal mediation and tracing are adapted to localize concept and attribute knowledge in text-to-image components.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Runtime reference-memory source to generated-region causality.

primary_sources.title: On Mechanistic Knowledge Localization in Text-to-Image Generative Models
primary_sources.supports: The paper reports architecture-sensitive limitations of causal tracing and uses direct cross-attention-layer intervention to localize knowledge.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Single selected runtime memory-source effects or geometry-supported output localization.

primary_sources.title: Towards Best Practices of Activation Patching in Language Models: Metrics and Methods
primary_sources.supports: Localization conclusions vary with corruption, restoration and metric choices.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: A video-memory protocol; it supplies methodological controls for coherent intervention and preregistered metrics.

primary_sources.title: Making Foresight Actionable: Repurposing Representation Alignment in World Action Models
primary_sources.code_status: No official repository was retrieved in the recorded title and author searches.
primary_sources.supports: Performs zero, mean, shuffle, and complement-swap interventions on world-model hidden spatial tokens, measures downstream action deviation, and evaluates localization against manually annotated interaction masks with a matched sensitivity ratio, robot-task success, and OOD tests.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: The target is a hidden spatial token, not a selected runtime memory item; the outcome is action deviation, not generated-video pixels. The checked materials do not document the target strict replay contract or show that an item-level causal score predicts natural revisit failures.

primary_sources.title: Trust but Verify: Adaptive Conditioning for Reference-Based Diffusion Super-Resolution via Implicit Reference Correlation Modeling
primary_sources.supports: Uses learnable summary tokens to estimate implicit low-quality-to-reference correlation and applies an online soft gate at each low-quality or output token to modulate reference-attention output; robustness is tested under irrelevant, blurred, affine-transformed, and variably matched references.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: It establishes online spatial gating for one external reference, but not a fixed-state causal audit of an episodic world-memory item, a geometry-derived pre-treatment support and area baseline, an abstain or re-observe action, or a per-example causal score predicting natural revisit failure.

primary_sources.title: Sufficient Context: A New Lens on Retrieval Augmented Generation Systems
primary_sources.supports: Separates insufficient retrieved context from model failure given sufficient context and trains guided abstention.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Geometric video evidence acceptance; it is cross-domain pressure against claiming abstention as a new abstraction.

primary_sources.title: RECOMP: Improving Retrieval-Augmented LMs with Context Compression and Selective Augmentation
primary_sources.supports: A context compressor can return an empty string when retrieved information is irrelevant or unhelpful.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Causal or geometry-aware acceptance in a video world model.

primary_sources.title: Conflict-Aware Soft Prompting for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
primary_sources.supports: Uses a context assessor and grounded or adversarial soft prompts to guide reliance on parametric versus external information under conflict.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: It pressures reliability-based source selection but does not establish runtime video-memory source-to-region causality.

primary_sources.title: Out of Sight, Out of Mind? Evaluating State Evolution in Video World Models
primary_sources.supports: Observation and control interventions benchmark state progression, plausibility and coherence when state is out of sight.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Which selected memory source caused which generated region.

primary_sources.title: MemoBench: Benchmarking World Modeling in Dynamically Changing Environments
primary_sources.venue_status: arXiv preprint; author project page labels ECCV 2026
primary_sources.supports: The benchmark measures disappear-reappear consistency using visual, motion, identity, 3D, camera and related output metrics.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Internal single-source causal consumption or acceptance.

primary_sources.title: Vision-Language Binding in In-Context Image Generation
primary_sources.venue_status: arXiv preprint; no proceedings claim is used in V2.
primary_sources.code_status: No official code URL was recorded during this V2 evidence update; this is an observation about the recorded evidence, not a claim that code does not exist.
primary_sources.supports: Analyzes causal pathways from a reference image to generated output in FLUX.2 using a T2I lens, attention knockout, and I2I-to-I2I activation patching; separates reference-to-text-to-image from direct reference-to-image pathways.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: It is not an intervention on one selected historical memory item in a video world model, does not define one coherent change across every real memory-consumption path, does not use a pre-treatment geometry support and area baseline, and does not link the score to natural revisit failure or benefit.

primary_sources.category: geometry-aware spatial memory and local control
primary_sources.title: MosaicMem: Hybrid Spatial Memory for Controllable Video World Models
primary_sources.venue_status: arXiv preprint; no proceedings claim is used in V2.
primary_sources.code_status: No official code URL was recorded during this V2 evidence update; this is an observation about the recorded evidence, not a claim that code does not exist.
primary_sources.supports: Lifts image patches into 3D for spatial localization and targeted retrieval, exposes a patch-and-compose interface, and supports memory-based scene editing in a controllable video world model.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: The checked primary material does not establish a fixed-state causal effect of one selected source or a natural-failure-linked acceptance score.

primary_sources.title: Compression and Retrieval: Implicit Memory Retrieval for Video World Models
primary_sources.venue_status: arXiv preprint; no proceedings claim is used in V2.
primary_sources.code_status: No official code URL was recorded during this V2 evidence update; this is an observation about the recorded evidence, not a claim that code does not exist.
primary_sources.supports: Uses attention-driven, viewpoint-conditioned implicit memory retrieval together with context compression for video world models.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: The checked primary material does not identify the target item-level fixed-state causal-localization and natural-benefit protocol.

primary_sources.category: general-purpose interactive world model with geometry memory retrieval
primary_sources.title: DreamX-World 1.0: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model
primary_sources.venue_status: arXiv preprint; no proceedings claim is used in V2.
primary_sources.code_status: No official code URL was recorded during this V2 evidence update; this is an observation about the recorded evidence, not a claim that code does not exist.
primary_sources.supports: Uses camera-geometry memory retrieval and memory-conditioned scene persistence, with residual recycling designed to tolerate imperfect memory latents.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Geometry retrieval, persistence, and robustness to imperfect memory latents do not by themselves establish a fixed-state source-to-region causal acceptance score.

negative_search_result.statement: Within the 24 primary sources checked in V2, no single work was identified that jointly performs intervention on one runtime-selected historical memory item, holds all remaining relevant state fixed, changes every real consumption path coherently, localizes generated-output effect against a pre-treatment geometry-support and area baseline, and links that causal-localized quantity to natural failure or benefit.
negative_search_result.interpretation: Bounded result for the checked set only. The expanded citation network is NOT_COMPLETED. This must not be rewritten as proof of field-wide absence or novelty.
highest_pressure_neighbors: Vision-Language Binding in In-Context Image Generation for causal reference-to-generated-output pathway analysis
AGRA for hidden-spatial-token causal intervention, mask comparison, matched sensitivity, and task benefit in a world-action-model interface
I2AM for reference-to-generated attribution with task masks and random-region baselines
Ada-RefSR for online per-output-token suppression of misleading references
Memory Forcing and ReMind for harmful or unreliable memory context and reliability-aware training
VMem, SPMEM, MosaicMem, Implicit Memory Retrieval, and DreamX-World for geometry-aware memory representation, routing, retrieval, and consumption

pre_gates: G0 stable real natural failure with camera and quality checks
A1 consumer influence and failure relevance
A2-A5 ordinary null, mean, nearest, generic and PoE-style baselines
decisive_experiment.main_intervention: Paired F11 versus F00 using one low-strength appearance-only edit applied coherently through every real consumer path, with retrieval IDs, pose, calibration, latents, actual sampling noise and RNG fixed.
decisive_experiment.localization: Compare in-mask effect concentration with the pre-treatment geometry-mask area baseline and report paired confidence intervals.
decisive_experiment.diagnostic_only: F10 CLIP-only and F01 replace-only expose cross-path conflict and are not the main causal estimand.
decisive_experiment.next_gate: Only after a positive causal-localization pilot, test whether the audit score predicts natural revisit error and whether acceptance has oracle headroom.

kill_criteria: Exact-replay variance is comparable to the measured effect
The memory consumer has no effect or no relevance to the natural failure
F11 total effect confidence lower bound does not exceed replay
Localization confidence lower bound does not exceed the mask-area baseline
Only inconsistent one-path interventions F10 or F01 produce a signal
The localization score does not incrementally predict natural error or benefit
Ordinary null, nearest, generic or PoE baselines absorb the effect
An oracle acceptance policy has no material headroom
The result does not replicate across scenes and a second consumer
A later citation-network audit finds an equivalent joint protocol

conditions.requirement: Intervene on one actual runtime-selected historical memory source or item.
Hold retrieval, camera, calibration, latents, actual sampling noise, RNG, and all other relevant internal state fixed.
Change the same source coherently across every real consumption path; one-path changes remain diagnostic only.
Localize the generated-output effect against a geometry-derived pre-treatment support and its area baseline.
Show that the causal-localized quantity predicts natural failure or benefit and supports an acceptance, rejection, or re-observation decision.

joint_gap_conditions.interpretation: No V2 source was assessed as satisfying C1-C5 jointly. This is not a novelty proof.
